about: The evangelium of the formulary “Visitation of the Blessed Virgin Mary” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: At that time, Mary, rising up, went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Judah; and she went into the house of Zechariah and greeted Elizabeth. And it came to pass that when Elizabeth heard the greeting of Mary, the infant leaped in her womb; and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit, and she exclaimed in a loud voice and said: Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb. And how has this fallen to me, that the mother of my Lord should come to me? For behold, as soon as the voice of your greeting sounded in my ears, the infant in my womb leaped with joy. And blessed are you who have believed, because the things that were spoken to you by the Lord will be fulfilled. And Mary said: My soul magnifies the Lord, and my spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior.
